Lydia Park: Tiny-viewport bug: when the left rail auto-collapses and the header switches to compact, the results table shows a horizontal overflow and focus sometimes disappears when tabbing. Seen on iPhone SE and Chrome 320px emulation. Screenshot: https://staging.redwood.internal/ux/ux-720.png

Kenji Sato: Repro'd on Pixel 3a emulator. The layout flip happens when the header wraps then the table recalculates width mid-frame. Long user IDs (40+ chars) make it worse.

Ava Ramirez: Accessibility note: screen readers read the truncated cell as "more" which is useless. We should keep visual truncation but add aria-label with full text and an aria-live confirmation for copy actions. Also keep min 44px tappable targets.

Chris Nolan: Two quick CSS-first ideas: clamp() the first column, and make the header position: sticky so wrapping doesn't affect document flow. POC: ```css
.results-id { min-width: 80px; max-width: clamp(72px, 26vw, 160px); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.header { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 5; }
.header--anim { transition: none; }
@media (max-width: 360px) { .action-label { display: none; } .action { min-width: 44px; } }
```
I'll try a minimal change on staging.

Lydia Park: Prefer an inline copy icon in the ID column instead of a "Show more" popover for mobile. Analytics show copy is the most common action. Copy button should announce "Copied ID" to aria-live.

Kenji Sato: Dev note: avoid disabling transitions globally. Toggle transition only during the collapse (add a class) and re-enable after 200ms. Also avoid forcing layout in JS. If we need scrollIntoView, wrap in requestAnimationFrame and only run when focus moved.

Ava Ramirez: a11y checklist: aria-label with full ID on the cell, copy button with aria-label="Copy ID 0x1234...", focus visible outline, overflow menu keyboard accessible, respects prefers-reduced-motion.

QA-Bot: Kicking off visual diffs for 320px and 360px, running keyboard navigation smoke, VoiceOver and TalkBack checks. Will report results here.

Deploy-Bot: Staging build 487 deployed to staging-ux (https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/487) :rocket:

Chris Nolan: PR created: feature/compact-ids. Includes CSS clamp, sticky header, and small JS toggle for transitions. Added visual tests for 320/360.

Lydia Park: Assigning @Chris to land, @Kenji to review reflows, @Ava for a11y. If green, push to canary tomorrow. Thanks! :thumbsup:
